BriarW.name: Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack
BriarW.tooltip:
Briar leaps and enters a Blood Frenzy, self-taunting to the nearest enemy for @BerserkDuration@ seconds, prioritizing Champions. While in Blood Frenzy she gains @BerserkAS*100@% Attack Speed and @BerserkMS*100@% Move Speed, and her Attacks deal @TotalAoEDamage@ physical damage to enemies surrounding her target.

Briar can Recast this Ability to empower her next Attack. It deals @TotalAttackBonusDamage@ + @TotalAttackPercentMissingHealth@% missing Health physical damage and heals Briar for @AttackMaxHPHeal@ + @AttackHealPercent*100@% of the damage dealt.

The bite deals @MonsterAndMinionPercentMod*100@% increased damage to minions and monsters (Max @MaxMonsterDamage@ missing health damage).
This ability does not remove or replace Certain Death's empowered Blood Frenzy.

BriarQ.name: Head Rush
BriarQ.tooltip:
Briar leaps to a target, Stunning it for @StunDuration@ seconds, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and reducing @ShredPercent*100@% Armor and Magic Resist for @ShredDuration@ seconds.

Briar will stop prioritizing champions if she casts this Ability on a minion or monster during Blood Frenzy.
This Ability applies %i:OnHit% On-Hit effects.

BriarP.name: Crimson Curse
BriarP.tooltip:
Briar's Attacks and Abilities apply a bleed for @BleedDuration@ seconds, stacking up to @MaxBleedStacks@ times. The bleed deals @BleedDamageOverDurationTooltip@ to @BleedMaxDamageOverDurationTooltip@ physical damage based on stacks, and Heals Briar for @HealPercent*100@% of the pre-mitigation damage.

Briar gains up to @TotalHealPerMissingHPPercentTooltip@% increased Healing based on her missing Health. She has no Base Health Regeneration and her Abilities cost @CurrentHealthPercentCost*100@% current Health to cast.

BriarR.name: Certain Death
BriarR.tooltip:
Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone and flies to the location of the first champion it hits, marking them as her prey. On landing, she deals @Damage@ magic damage to everything nearby and causes enemies who are not her prey to Flee for @FearDuration@ seconds. She then enters an empowered Blood Frenzy and will pursue her prey until death. During this time, she gains @TotalResists@ Armor and Magic Resist, @LifeStealPercent*100@% Lifesteal, and an additional @ExtraMoveSpeedPercent*100@% Move Speed.
When the hemolith hits it interrupts channeled Abilities. Briar has True Sight of her prey.

BriarE.name: Chilling Scream
BriarE.tooltip:
Begin Charging: Briar removes Blood Frenzy and gathers energy, gaining @DRPercent@% damage reduction and restoring @PercentMaxHPHeal@ Health over 1 second.

Release: Briar unleashes a scream that deals up to @Damage@ magic damage based on time charged, and Slows by @SlowPercent*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. When fully charged, the scream Knocks Back enemies, dealing @WallHitDamage@ magic damage to those who hit a wall and Stunning them for @WallStunDuration@ seconds.
